title: Ewris Harolds
description: A lightweight, low-grind Create modpack built for performance. Relax, build factories, and enjoy smooth FPS.
body:
Welcome to **Ewris Harolds**! If you're looking for a stress-free engineering experience, you've come to the right place. This modpack is designed with a specific goal in mind: **maximum fun with minimum grind**, all while keeping the mod count low enough to run on just about any computer (yes, even that potato laptop).

The focus here is purely on the **Create** mod and its best add-ons, supported by storage solutions and Quality of Life tweaks to make your building experience smooth and satisfying.

> **🚧 Heads Up: Early Development**
> Just a quick note: this modpack is still fresh out of the oven! Since we are in the early stages, **things might change**. We are actively testing and tweaking the balance, so expect some updates that could add new features, remove bugs, or slightly alter the mod list. We appreciate your patience as we polish things up!

### 🤔 Wait, "Ewris Harolds"?
Yeah, about the name... honestly, don't overthink it! It's just a silly inside joke among my friend group that stuck. It doesn't mean anything mystical or deep

---

## Key Features ⚙️

### 🧪 Custom Recipe Tweaks
We don't want you spending hours crafting a single gear.
* **Powered by KubeJS:** We are using KubeJS to simplify some recipes and cut down on the tedious grind.
* **Current Status:** We haven't changed *everything* yet—just a few specific recipes to improve the flow. Expect more tweaks in the future as we find more ways to make your life easier!

### 🚂 The Engineering Core
We kept it focused. No magic bloat, just pure machinery.
* **Create:** The star of the show. Build complex factories, trains, and contraptions.
* **Create Add-ons:** We've included **Power Loader**, **Railways Navigator**, and **Contraption Terminals** to expand your logistical possibilities without overwhelming you.

### 🎒 Quality of Life & Storage
We hate inventory clutter as much as you do.
* **Storage Solutions:** Organize your massive item yield with **Tom's Simple Storage Mod** and **Sophisticated Storage**.
* **On the Go:** Carry more with **Sophisticated Backpacks** (fully integrated with Create!).
* **Helpers:** Use **Construction Sticks** to build faster, **Carry On** to move chests without breaking them, and **Antique Atlas** for stylish navigation.

### 🚀 Extreme Optimization
This is a huge priority for this pack. We want everyone to play, regardless of their specs.
* Packed with performance mods like **Sodium**, **Lithium**, **Ferrite Core**, **ImmediatelyFast**, and **EntityCulling**.
* Super fast load times and stable FPS, making it perfect for servers with friends.

---

## Why Play This?
* **Zero Bloat:** We only added what matters.
* **Relaxing Gameplay:** Reduced grind mechanics allow you to focus on aesthetics and engineering.
* **Multiplayer Friendly:** Essential features like **Simple RPC** and **Open to LAN** (via e4mc) make playing with friends a breeze.

Grab your wrench, invite your friends, and start building!
